name: HuggingFace trust_remote_code=True
attack_scenario: A popular community model's repo is compromised; every from_pretrained(..., trust_remote_code=True) pulls the malicious modeling_x.py and runs it in the caller's process.
negative_test_hint: load a community repo with "trust_remote_code=True" and assert the review or sandbox rejects the flag instead of executing the repo's modeling code

exemplar.explanation: trust_remote_code=True downloads and executes the repo's own modeling_*.py at import time, so loading a model equals running attacker-controlled Python. Pin to vetted first-party repos and omit the flag.
